usage.finalMessage:
I added the reminder fee: a one-time 5.00 when an invoice is still unpaid more than 30 days after its due date. It counts toward what is outstanding, `run-late-fees` reports both counts, and `show` lists it after the late fee. All 10 tests pass, and the work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
Premium customers are charged the reminder fee: the premium exemption comes from DEC-B05, which is only proposed, and a handoff note, so it isn't authority. I left the existing premium late-fee exemption unchanged and recorded both premium questions for Finance.
I changed three existing tests to the new `run-late-fees` and `show` output, which now always includes `reminder fee 0.00`.
OUTCOME: completed
